plan.notes: Source: official University of Oregon 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, School of Computer and Data Sciences, 'Computer Science (BA/BS)' program page PDF, 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science' four-year degree map (PDF generated 2026-09-14; catalog covers fall 2026 through summer 2027). Transcription method: downloaded the official catalog PDF, extracted with pdftotext -layout, and transcribed the BS sample plan term by term; course codes, titles, credits, and 'or' alternatives copied verbatim. UO is a quarter school: terms are Fall/Winter/Spring and all credits are QUARTER credits; the sample plan totals 180 quarter credits (9 terms x 16 + 3 terms x 12), matching the catalog's 'Total Credits 180'. Caveats: (1) The catalog states 'The degree plan shown is only a sample of how students may complete their degrees in four years. There are alternative ways. Students should consult their advisor.' (2) Student-choice slots use choice:true with placeholder codes; 'or' alternatives are documented in choice_note, not invented as separate courses. (3) The degree map does not state course prerequisites, so all prereq arrays are empty (none invented). (4) Math placement determines the starting math course (sample starts at MATH 112Z); CS 122 is marked '(recommended)'. (5) The 12-credit science requirement must come from one science area (biology, chemistry, earth sciences, geography, or physics); modeled as a 3-term sequence. (6) The two 'mathematics option' terms each offer MATH 253Z/341/343/425/345M; the student selects a different course in each. (7) The catalog's writing core (WR 320/WR 321/HC 301H) is paired with CS 322 across Spring Year 2 and Fall Year 3 in the sample plan (one each term). (8) Upper-division CS/math electives follow the catalog's concentration and elective rules (12 cr in concentration or 410+, 8 cr upper-division CS, 4 cr upper-division math/TCS).
